title: Synergistic evolution of key-region flexibility maintenance and global scaffold Rigidification enhances lipase performance for vitamin E succinate synthesis.
authors: Zhang, Yu; Zheng, Bingqian; Du, Jiaxiang; Chen, Zhiheng; Zhang, Zihan; Liu, Qingqing; Fan, Yutai; Gao, Zhen; Zheng, Weiyi; Hu, Yi; Nian, Binbin
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过结合关键区域柔性维持与整体骨架刚性化的理性设计策略改造脂肪酶，利用分子动力学模拟解析构象动态重分布，属于蛋白质结构计算辅助的酶工程应用，方法创新性中等但问题与方法均与蛋白质结构计算相关。
abstract: Industrial biocatalysts require both high activity and stability, yet natural enzymes often exhibit an activity-stability trade-off that limits practical use. Therefore, this study aimed to develop and validate a rational design strategy integrating key-region flexibility maintenance, which preserves catalytically relevant local dynamics, with global scaffold rigidification, which stabilizes the broader protein framework. Using Bacillus subtilis lipase A (BSLA) as a model enzyme, M4 was identified as the optimal variant. At 52  degrees C, M4 had a half-life 94.52 times that of the wild type (WT) and showed enhanced tolerance to several organic solvents. Following treatment with dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO) at 40  degrees C for 15 min, M4 exhibited 2.29 times the post-treatment activity of WT. Moreover, its catalytic activity was 4.35 times that of WT. To evaluate its application potential, M4 was further evaluated in vitamin E succinate (VES) synthesis. After reaction optimization, a VES yield of 91.83% was achieved at a substrate molar ratio of 1:4, an enzyme loading of 15 mg/mL, and 55  degrees C within 21 h. Structural analyses and molecular dynamics simulations indicated that M4 preserved flexibility in catalytically important regions while increasing the rigidity of the overall protein scaffold. This redistribution of conformational dynamics provides a structural explanation for the simultaneous enhancement of catalytic activity and stability. Compared with conventional single-strategy approaches, the proposed framework simultaneously improved catalytic activity, thermostability, and organic-solvent tolerance and demonstrated its practical applicability through efficient VES synthesis.
abstract_zh: 工业生物催化剂需要兼具高活性和高稳定性，然而天然酶常表现出活性-稳定性权衡，限制了其实际应用。因此，本研究旨在开发并验证一种理性设计策略，该策略整合了关键区域柔性保持（保留催化相关的局部动力学）与整体骨架刚性化（稳定更广泛的蛋白质框架）。以枯草芽孢杆菌脂肪酶A（BSLA）为模型酶，M4被确定为最优变体。在52°C下，M4的半衰期是野生型（WT）的94.52倍，并表现出对多种有机溶剂增强的耐受性。经40°C下二甲基亚砜（DMSO）处理15分钟后，M4的处理后活性是WT的2.29倍。此外，其催化活性是WT的4.35倍。为评估其应用潜力，M4进一步在维生素E琥珀酸酯（VES）合成中进行了评价。经反应优化后，在底物摩尔比1:4、酶载量15 mg/mL、55°C条件下，21小时内VES产率达到91.83%。结构分析和分子动力学模拟表明，M4在催化重要区域保持了柔性，同时增加了整体蛋白质骨架的刚性。这种构象动力学的重新分布为催化活性和稳定性的同时提升提供了结构解释。与传统的单一策略方法相比，所提出的框架同时提高了催化活性、热稳定性和有机溶剂耐受性，并通过高效的VES合成展示了其实用适用性。
